headline: White-Collar and Blue-Collar Industry Job Growth in the 150 Largest US Metro Areas, 2019 to 2023
dek: Industry groups standing in for white- and blue-collar work: private financial activities and professional and business services against goods-producing industries. Jobs are counted by employer industry, not occupation.
universe: The 150 largest metropolitan areas by 2019 total covered employment, Puerto Rico included
subject: C1242

x.label: Finance and professional services jobs, change 2019 to 2023

size.label: change in total covered jobs, 2019 to 2023

source.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages

change-total-covered.method: bubble = 2023 − 2019 annual average total covered employment, all industries and ownerships

source.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages

growth.method: growth = (2023 / 2019 − 1) × 100 of private annual average jobs summed over QCEW industries 1023 + 1024 (horizontal) and 1011 + 1012 + 1013 (vertical); null if any part is withheld
